text: The Corporations Nominating Panel will conduct interviews and recommend three public members for appointment to the Waterfront Toronto Board.

City Council on June 25 and 26, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following public members to the Waterfront Toronto Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending June 27, 2028, and until successors are appointed. Derek Ballantyne; Laurie Payne; and Matti Siemiatycki. 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 3 to the report (June 3, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Waterfront Toronto. Confidential Attachments 1 to 3 to the report (June 3, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Waterfront Toronto.
